class.name: FauxBuildView
class.brief_description: Presents the FauxBuild world through Godot rendering.

description.para: The rendering adapter for a FauxBuild world. In later milestones this node owns the camera adapter, GPU resources, shaders, the geometry cache, portal-visible instance state, render interpolation, and debug drawing. It consumes world data from [FauxBuildRuntime]; it never becomes the authority for world state.
Milestone M1 scope: class registration only.
